summary: Amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to exclude from compensable working hours any voluntary time employees spend outside their regular schedule attending or participating in education, training, or similar programs (whether employer-offered or not), as long as they perform no work for the employer during that time and face no adverse action for nonparticipation.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly modifies the definition of 'hours worked' under the Fair Labor Standards Act, which is a foundational labor law. By excluding certain voluntary training from compensable hours, it provides more flexibility for employers regarding training costs and employee time, thus leaning towards employer flexibility.
